reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5 — swept the stale subdomain out of every canonical, share link and policy line
method: Verified in the built page via preview, not read from source. Before: every page declared <link rel=canonical> and og:url on https://photography.ninochavez.co — a host apps/router 301-redirects — while the sitemap listed https://ninochavez.co/photography, so a crawler got two different answers to 'where does this page live' from the same page. photoShareUrl built every copy-link and social share on that same redirecting host. After: canonical, og:url and share links all resolve to https://ninochavez.co/photography/... An intermediate version of this change doubled the base path (https://ninochavez.co/photography/photography/privacy) because $page.url.pathname already carries paths.base; caught by reading the rendered tag rather than trusting the edit, and fixed by composing the layout fallback from SITE_ORIGIN. Confirmed across /, /privacy, /about, /albums, /favorites and /photo/DSC06067 — all six now emit a single, non-redirecting canonical. Reader-facing copy changed in one place: the privacy overview said 'operates photography.ninochavez.co', a domain that no longer serves the gallery; it now reads 'operates this gallery at ninochavez.co/photography', verified in the rendered page.
